record.question:
How does the Mizoram Bana Kaih (Handholding) Scheme, 2024 promote entrepreneurship and
     MSME development?
options: By providing only direct grants to existing large enterprises
By facilitating credit linkage, credit guarantees, interest subvention and handholding support
By reserving all government procurement exclusively for new entrepreneurs
By replacing commercial bank financing with direct government lending
